The organiser detail page does not state an entry fee; some children's activities are listed as free, with food, purchases and other activities extra.

events.tagZh: 市中心 · 万圣节表演
events.summaryZh: 沿海港看巨型木偶和流动骷髅表演，孩子还可以画脸；提前在 Darling Quarter 玩一会儿，再到 Cockle Bay 接上傍晚节目。 画脸16:00–19:00；巨型木偶17:00–19:00；流动表演17:30–20:30。
